description: Utility functions for managing and retrieving product information within the Mattermost web application, including product selection, filtering, and scope checking.

methods.name: getCurrentProductId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the current product based on the products list and current URL pathname.

methods.name: getCurrentProduct
methods.description: Finds and returns the current product component based on the products list and URL pathname.

methods.name: useProducts
methods.description: React hook to retrieve the list of product components from the Redux store.

methods.name: useCurrentProductId
methods.description: React hook to get the current product ID based on the URL pathname.

methods.name: useCurrentProduct
methods.description: React hook to get the current product component based on the URL pathname.

methods.name: inScope
methods.description: Checks if a product or plugin ID is within a specified scope.

methods.name: isChannels
methods.description: Determines if the given product ID corresponds to channels (null ID).

methods.name: findProductBySkuAndInterval
methods.description: Finds a product by SKU and recurring interval.

methods.name: findProductByID
methods.description: Finds a product by its ID.

methods.name: findOnlyYearlyProducts
methods.description: Filters and returns only products with a yearly recurring interval.
